note: Fictional. A woman in Sapporo applies for public assistance and writes that she has no siblings so the ward office will not contact her brother. The caseworker finds him in the family register. What happened on the stairs in 2001 cannot be settled: the hospital record is gone, the counsellor and their mother are dead, and he remembers nothing of the night.
